title: The Best Yearbook
author: Ada Pemberton
blurb: Xanthe Vasquez, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
